long_biography.plain_text:
When Oyster Yachts entered administration, Richard Hadida bought its assets and unfinished boats, acquired the hull-building plant and brought founder Richard Matthews back to the board. The move placed a historic British manufacturer under an owner who already knew its products as a customer, but now faced the practical work of restoring design, production and support.

Hadida remains Oyster's chairman and controlling shareholder while a separate chief executive manages day-to-day delivery. He has backed new models, in-house production and updated manufacturing methods, combining software-era product thinking with British boatbuilding. His stewardship has focused on rebuilding the company as an integrated designer, manufacturer and long-term service provider for bluewater sailing yachts.

uncertainties.detail: Oyster directly identifies Richard Hadida as both company owner and owner of Lush, while Forbes and Soundings Trade Only independently repeat the same person, business and vessel combination. Companies House adds the exact legal name, birth month and year, nationality, residence and control chain. This produces a 99-confidence resolution; private-vessel facts are excluded from biographies, classifications and tags.

Technology was tested because Evolution describes advanced IT and product development, but the company was specifically created to deliver live casino products online and Hadida's documented founder stake arose in that business. Gambling & Casinos is therefore the more causal creation sector. Technology remains part of the mechanism rather than the primary taxonomy label.

Oyster is Hadida's clearest current controlled operating asset: he is its chairman, direct majority shareholder and controller of the additional corporate shareholder. Manufacturing is used for current industry because Oyster designs and builds yachts. Operator is used for relationship because he acquired rather than founded Oyster and now supplies ownership and strategic direction while a separate chief executive manages delivery. His post-listing residual Evolution ownership, if any, is not established by current public evidence.

Official sources establish that Hadida co-founded Evolution and held a material pre-listing stake. His own career account records leaving college, entering work through the job centre, learning software in employment and later developing internet products. It also mentions a successful father and an earlier professional investment network, but does not document family capital, a family business transfer or the exact financing of Evolution. Broad Self-made is therefore more defensible than either independent-start or advantaged-start.

The authoritative record says Monaco. Several current identity-verified Companies House appointments also say Monaco, while the Oyster Yachts Holdings appointment and direct PSC entry retain United Kingdom residence. The Monaco value is preserved rather than reproposed; the company-specific discrepancy is recorded without treating it as proof of a move.

Companies House securely establishes the middle name Ashley and reconfirms June 1965, so Ashley is proposed for the blank middle-names field. No reliable source established an exact birth day or place of birth. Growing up in London is not treated as evidence of birth there, and those fields remain blank.

The proposed LinkedIn is authenticated by exact name, current Oyster organisation, direct company link and sustained role-specific activity, and is distinguished from several French namesakes. The official Oyster site is proposed as a Company Website. Searches of Instagram, Personal Website, Facebook, Twitter/X, YouTube, TikTok and Wikipedia did not establish another personal profile with an official cross-link or two strong independent anchors.

Forbes has exact-person editorial coverage confirming Hadida's current Oyster role and identity bridge, but no dedicated personal profile was found. The dossier therefore records Forbes as not_found and does not propose a Forbes social.

Gambling and Online gambling & betting are assigned together because the catalogue requires the broad gambling umbrella for the evidenced digital specialism. Casino operations is excluded because Evolution supplied technology and live games to operators rather than running the customer casinos. Superyacht construction is the sole maritime-manufacturing assignment because Oyster's current range and Hadida's control meet the specific contract; the broader Shipbuilding tag is omitted as a same-dimension overlap.
